summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.76/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.76 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 11¢ lower than a week ago, 14¢ higher than a month ago, and 96¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.57) and the highest in Superior ($3.98).
